name: Go subscriptions
summary: Quillwork, a team plan sold through Stripe Checkout: a Vue 3 single-page app on a Go JSON API and Postgres, whose Stripe webhook starts the plan and sends a welcome email through Resend.
runsOn: A Go server and its Vue app in Chromium, with Postgres in Docker
shows: A Go app behind danwo's proxy with no Node preload: Go's own HTTPS_PROXY support, and danwo's CA trusted through the SSL_CERT_FILE danwo sets, on Linux and macOS
A Vue single-page app whose calls to the Go API go through danwo's proxy, so the flight record shows them and the matrix fails them: 500s, dropped connections, lost answers and double submits
The official Stripe and Resend Go SDKs against the emulators, a webhook verified with the Stripe SDK and deduped in the activation's transaction
Invariants that read both sides: one plan per Stripe subscription with Stripe's status, one Checkout Session and one welcome email per team
`danwo matrix` faulting the page's API calls, Stripe, Resend, the webhooks and Postgres (44 trials), and `QUILLWORK_BUG` switches the matrix catches
